attempts.summary: Configured node1 as the persistent OpenWrt gateway. Trusted network: 192.168.10.0/24 on eth2 for node2/node4. Guest network: 192.168.20.0/24 on eth3 for node3. Both receive DHCP, DNS, NAT, and internet access. app.home.test resolves to node2 at 192.168.10.10:8080; trusted clients can access it while guest traffic is blocked. All nodes passed sequential restart and recovery verification.
